summary: Spark I Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K after its September 25, 2026 extraordinary general meeting approving an extension of its initial business combination deadline from September 29, 2026 to March 29, 2027. Sponsor SLG SPAC Fund LLC will lend the trust $0.015 per public share outstanding after redemptions, up to roughly $201,304, evidenced by a non-interest-bearing promissory note of up to $400,000. The filing also covers charter amendments, a direct financial obligation, unregistered equity sales, and shareholder votes. Watch redemption levels, trust balance, and any deal announcement before March 2027, since failure to close risks liquidation.
